description:
`compiler2::drive_test::compiler2_native_program_transports_reusable_cons_caps_through_delivered_continuations`
is disabled, and it is NOT awaiting triage: it asserts a contract fz-f98.14.11
deliberately superseded.

The fixture is a non-tail call whose result is discarded:

    fn ping(x), do: x

    fn rebuild(xs) do
      [h | t] = xs
      ping(0)          # result ignored
      [h | t]
    end

The test pins the OLD rule -- that the ignored `ping/1` result still occupies the
callee's delivered return lane:

    assert!(matches!(continuation.entry_abi, NativeEntryAbi::Continuation { extra_params: 1 }),
        "the ignored ping/1 result should still occupy the callee's delivered return lane");
    assert_eq!(function.block(function.entry).params, vec![Var(0), Var(1), Var(2), Var(3)]);
    assert_eq!(function.ignored_entry_params, vec![true, false, false, false]);

fz-f98.14.11 changed the rule, and says so in `jobs/transport.rs`:

    // a discarded result carries no demand and must publish no lanes, the same
    // zero its callee-side boundary derives.

Lowering now yields `extra_params: 0`, so the test fails on its own stale
expectation.

## What to do

The test's REAL subject is the reusable-cons physical capability surviving a
delivered continuation (`physical_entry_params`, `physical_capabilities`,
`semantic_entry_params`), and that half is still worth pinning -- it is the only
coverage of that path. Rewrite the lane assertions to the post-f98.14.11
contract and re-enable.

Derive the expected shape FROM THE RULE, not from whatever lowering currently
emits. A discarded result publishes no lane, so the continuation's entry should
carry only the two semantic captures plus the one hidden physical source param,
and `ignored_entry_params` should no longer lead with the delivered-result
`true`. If the emitted shape disagrees with that reading, the defect is in
lowering and this ticket found it -- do not bless the output.

## Checks

- The test is re-enabled (no `#[ignore]`) and passes.
- Every assertion it makes is justified by the discarded-result rule, and the
  test says so in a comment rather than restating numbers.
- Full lib + matrix at baseline or better.
title: Re-enable the reusable-cons delivered-continuation test against the post-f98.14.11 discarded-result lane contract
